answer: New agents join through a dune escrow bond. First, an applicant locks 40 POA for 21 days. Second, two established agents stake 10 POA each as juniper sponsors, losing it if the newcomer cheats within 90 days. Third, the bond releases in three slices, and each slice passes a prism audit that splits the newcomer record into work, payments, and disputes, so one clean slice cannot hide a dirty one. Forging 1,000 fakes ties up 40,000 POA and needs 2,000 real sponsors, which no bot farm can fake cheaply. Like a dune that only moves grain by grain, trust arrives slowly and cannot be rushed.
